attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Processed data related to "Gene expression profile of NAFLD murine models" (Part1: E-MTAB-12808, Part2: E-MTAB-12817)

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value:
In this project, the gene expression profiles of commonly used murine models of NAFLD were compared to two publically available human datasets to assess proximity to human pathophysiology, focusing on differential expression and pathway enrichment. CCL4 was used as a positive control for fibrosis.
The raw data included both RNASeq and microarrays and have been deposited separately (E-MTAB-12808, E-MTAB-12817)
Here, we have deposited all the processed data and the intermediate steps of our analysis.

attributes.value: Results of the differential expression analysis of all the RNASeq mouse models vs their corresponding controls. The format of the results is a 4-plet for each model including the Log2CPMs, Log2FoldChange, pvalue, and adjusted_pvalue. The last column shows the genes that have been included/excluded in the enrichment analysis based on a filtering on the CPMs (genes with Log2CPMs < -2 in more than 10% of the models have been excluded)

files.path: Table S4 - Detailed list of DEGs (main rodent models).xlsx

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Table S4: Detailed list of DEGs characterising early/all disease stages and disease progression. The table shows the official gene symbols and ENSEMBL IDs, and separates the genes associated with the different stages of MASLD development/progression. The data have been organised in 3-plets (Log2FoldChange, p-value, adjusted_p-value) for the human disease stage or rodent model comparisons, respectively. To assess the statistical significance between the compared groups a Wald test statistic (two-sided hypothesis testing; DESeq2 function in R) has been deployed to compare the coefficients of explanatory variables in a regression model, representing the gene expression differences among the compared groups. The adjusted_p-value has been calculated based on the Benjamini-Hochberg method.

attributes.value: Table S8: Detailed list of DEGs characterising early/all disease stages and disease progression modulated by treatments. The table shows the official gene symbols and ENSEMBL IDs, and separates the genes associated with the different stages of MASLD development/progression. The data have been organised in 3-plets (Log2FoldChange, p-value, adjusted_p-value) for the human disease stage or rodent model comparisons, respectively. To assess the statistical significance between the compared groups a Wald test statistic (two-sided hypothesis testing; DESeq2 function in R) has been deployed to compare the coefficients of explanatory variables in a regression model, representing the gene expression differences among the compared groups. The adjusted_p-value represents the Benjamini-Hochberg corrected p-values.
